name: Find and open an institution
steps: Choose Institution name or Institution code, type a value and press Enter. Open Filters for status, school setup, license and access policy; apply, clear, sort and paginate. Open the name link or row; use the sliders-icon Manage action.
outcome: The selected institution’s own data is shown. Returning preserves search, filters and page.
alternate_states: Empty directory, no matches, loading, load failure and inaccessible record.
implementation_contract: Directory fields and filter values must be validated server-side; never retrieve other operators’ unauthorized scopes.

name: Review an institution
steps: Inspect Overview, Branches, Modules, Administrators and Activity. Review access, active branches, administrator handover, licensing and recent configuration changes. School-owned readiness is a secondary summary.
outcome: Availability, setup readiness and administrator activation remain distinct.
alternate_states: Inactive institution banner; branch readiness pending; administrator activation pending.
implementation_contract: Configuration metadata only; operator or institution-admin status does not automatically allow operational student, financial or health records.

name: Update institution details
steps: Edit name, contact and notes. Record a reason; review before saving. The institution code is stable.
outcome: Save current-version data and an audit event.
alternate_states: Invalid email/name, duplicate name warning, failed save and concurrent edit.
implementation_contract: Do not mutate another institution. Reject stale versions; keep values in the editor until the user explicitly reloads the latest record.

name: Start and complete onboarding
steps: Start empty; complete Institution → First branch → Modules → Administrator → Review. Verify identity independently. Submit once.
outcome: One institution and first branch are created; the verified administrator’s access follows the account’s actual activation state. New branches start setup-required with Attendance inactive.
alternate_states: Required-field errors, duplicate code/name, reused account, unverified identity, forbidden action and uncertain submit result.
implementation_contract: Email equality is not identity proof. Reuse existing Access/Tenancy use cases and lock order. Resolve the original command receipt before retrying. Prototype-local atomicity does not establish production transaction boundaries.

name: Save and resume a draft
steps: Save partial values; return later to My drafts; Resume returns to the saved step and restores values.
outcome: Draft data, step, owner, version and last-saved time persist; no institution exists until successful submission.
alternate_states: Empty draft disabled; storage/save failure; draft unavailable; other owner; completed or discarded draft; stale draft version.
implementation_contract: Draft owner is the default editor. Approved reassignment is a separate workflow; do not infer shared visibility from operator status. Reauthorize on read, resume and submit.

name: Discard or finish a draft
entry: My drafts → Discard, or final submission
steps: Confirm discarding unfinished setup. On successful creation, mark the source draft completed and link its institution.
outcome: Discarded/completed drafts leave the active drafts list; existing institutions never change on draft discard.
alternate_states: Double discard, concurrent submission, stale version and permission denial.
implementation_contract: Soft lifecycle transitions with metadata-only evidence. Do not use draft deletion as a cascade into production records.

name: Leave or sign out during editing
entry: Sidebar, browser Back, leave utility or Sign out
steps: Prompt only for unsaved changes. Save and leave, keep working or explicitly discard unsaved edits. If unchanged, leave directly.
outcome: A failed save keeps the user and edits on the page. Discard keeps any previously saved draft. Sign-out occurs only after a requested save succeeds.
alternate_states: Failed save, session expiry, browser reload and storage unavailable.
implementation_contract: Real sign-out must invalidate the current server session. Protected views reauthorize on browser Back. Retention of unsaved edits across reauthentication is a policy decision, not permission to persist credentials.

name: Deactivate an institution
steps: Review named institution and affected branches, provide a reason, acknowledge impact and confirm.
outcome: Institution status becomes Inactive. Protected school access is denied here; configuration and records are retained.
alternate_states: Cancel, failed save, stale status/version, unauthorized operation and repeated request.
implementation_contract: Server guards must deny new protected requests from existing sessions. Do not disable global accounts or other institution memberships. Drain/cancel tenant jobs per documented policy; define in-flight mutation locking before implementation.

name: Reactivate an institution
steps: Review remaining restrictions, provide a reason and confirm.
outcome: Institution becomes Active. Individually inactive branches, revoked memberships, setup requirements and license restrictions remain.
alternate_states: Changed prerequisites, conflicting operator action and failed save.
implementation_contract: Do not mass-enable branches, users or modules. Re-evaluate effective availability; no data restoration is needed because deactivation did not delete it.

name: Manage branches
steps: Add or edit branch configuration. Review readiness. Deactivate/reactivate one branch with a reason.
outcome: New branch has no implicit school-record grants, requires setup and starts with Attendance inactive. Changes affect only that branch.
alternate_states: Duplicate code, inactive institution, last/only active branch notice, invalid time zone, stale update and failure.
implementation_contract: Choose a supported time zone at branch creation. Existing branch time zones are read-only; reject changed values in the application use case, even if the client is modified. A future exceptional migration requires separate impact analysis and authorization. Last-branch deactivation can leave the institution Active but with no available school workspace; show that consequence.

name: Manage licensed modules
steps: Review approved agreement, change Attendance licensing, add approval reference and reason. Foundations remain included.
outcome: Removing a license makes Attendance unavailable across branches and clears activation; records remain. Adding a license does not activate branches.
alternate_states: Unreleased module, invalid approval, stale configuration and failed save.
implementation_contract: Separate platform commercial entitlement from branch activation. Preserve module ownership and existing TEN-02 checks. Adding other products later requires their actual release/dependency contracts.

name: Review branch activation
steps: Check institution active, branch active, module licensed and school setup ready. Activate or deactivate with reason if authorized.
outcome: Only the selected branch’s Attendance availability changes.
alternate_states: Unmet prerequisites, lost capability, changed license and failed save.
implementation_contract: Require explicit branch-module configuration capability; platform role alone is insufficient. Recheck all prerequisites in the write transaction.

name: Add verified administrator access
steps: Enter identity, independent verification reference and branch setup scope; review account reuse before confirming.
outcome: Grant institution configuration access. Existing account credentials/memberships remain. New accounts await the approved activation path.
alternate_states: Duplicate membership, existing account ownership not confirmed, institution inactive, no verification and save failure.
implementation_contract: Preserve IAM-02/03 operator-assisted bootstrap and account-wide trust constraints. Do not grant student-record roles, reset credentials or send arbitrary invitations from this console.

name: Check administrator activation
steps: Complete the approved external/operator-assisted process, then Check activation status.
outcome: Only a verified activation result updates status. Pending remains pending until a real result arrives.
alternate_states: Still pending, unavailable identity service, expired request and revoked access.
implementation_contract: Never make an operator checkbox or email match an activation proof. The review toolbar can simulate the external result; production must query the owning Access contract.

name: Change or revoke administrator access
entry: Administrator → Manage branch access / Revoke access
steps: Review institution-specific scope and reason. Prevent revoking the last active administrator until a replacement is active.
outcome: Only this institution’s configuration grants change. Other institutions and the global identity remain.
alternate_states: Last active admin, replacement still pending, expired operator session, conflict and failure.
implementation_contract: Last-admin check must be transactionally serialized to prevent two concurrent revocations leaving no administrator. Operator recovery remains a separately controlled path.

name: Inspect activity
entry: Global Audit trail or institution Activity
steps: Filter by institution, action, actor and date; open event detail. Return to the appropriate institution.
outcome: Global navigation is truly cross-institution metadata within permission scope; institution activity is scoped.
alternate_states: No events, no matches, unavailable event and permission denial.
implementation_contract: Write audit metadata atomically with configuration changes when ownership permits; otherwise durable outbox. Exclude passwords, raw tokens, raw identity evidence and draft field contents. Times display Asia/Kolkata; store UTC.

name: Recover from failure or a stale edit
steps: Keep entered values after failure. Retry transient saves. For conflicts, review current stored values; explicitly reload and reapply edits.
outcome: No silent overwrite or false success. Unknown onboarding outcome uses the original request reference.
alternate_states: Save failure, load failure, conflict, record missing, unknown submission and status-check failure.
implementation_contract: Retry create only with the same idempotency key and payload contract. Expected versions must be checked server-side; UI disabling is not a concurrency control.

name: Navigate with limited access or on mobile
steps: Use the mobile menu and explicit sign-out; navigate name links and actions by keyboard. Review as read-only; recover from session expiry.
outcome: Read-only users inspect allowed metadata but cannot change it. Mobile menu and dialogs maintain a clear navigation path.
alternate_states: Access denied, direct protected URL, expired session, keyboard focus, narrow viewport and reduced motion.
implementation_contract: Production authentication, authorization, CSRF, tenant isolation and audit enforcement remain server-owned. Native assistive-technology and browser verification are required before claiming conformance.
